title: Notice of Possession under Acquisition of Land Act (Freeport, Grand Bahama)
text:
EXTRAORDINARY
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
THE BAHAMAS
PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY
NASSAU 18th March, 2026 (A)

OFFICE OF THE PRIME MINISTER
COMMONWEALTH OF THE BAHAMAS
FREEPORT, GRAND BAHAMA
NOTICE OF POSSESSION
Given Under
THE ACQUISITION OF LAND ACT
Chapter 252
WHEREAS by Declaration of Intended Acquisition dated 19th day of January,
A.D., 2026 and published in the Extraordinary Gazette dated 20th day of January,
A.D., 2026, the Minister responsible for the Acquisition and Disposition of Lands,
the Promoter, declared that it was his intention to acquire the land described in the
Schedule hereto for a public purpose, namely, inner city revitalization and resilient
community re-development and for uses related thereto.
AND WHEREAS the Minister responsible for Acquisition and Disposition
of Lands, is of the opinion that possession of the said land should be obtained
before payment is made to the rightful claimants thereto.

NOW THEREFORE it is hereby declared that the said land has been
appropriated by the Minister responsible for Acquisition and Disposition of Lands
for the purpose mentioned in the said Declaration of Intended Acquisition with
effect from the date hereof.
Dated this 18th day of March, A.D., 2026.
Signed
PHILIP E. DAVIS
Minister Responsible for
The Acquisition and Disposition of Lands
Schedule (Annexed)
3

SCHEDULE
AREA = 2.268 ACRES
ALL THAT certain lot piece or parcel of land comprising Eight (8) contiguous
Lots numbered 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79, and 80 (hereinafter referred to as the
said parcel of land) containing by admeasurement Two and Two Hundred Sixty-
eight Thousandths (2.268) Acres or thereabouts being the Parcel shown on a plan
on record in Department of Lands and Surveys File numbered L&S 5028/XXV
and situate immediately north of Hudson Avenue approximately One Hundred
and Ten (110) Feet east of Frobisher Drive in East Section One of the Freeport
City Subdivision in the Island of Grand Bahama in the Commonwealth of
The Bahamas ABUTTING AND BOUNDING towards the North on Drake
Avenue (Fifty (50) Feet wide public road) towards the East being partly on the
Lot numbered Eighty-two (82) and being partly on the Lot numbered Eighty-
one (81) towards the South on Hudson Avenue (Fifty (50) Feet wide public
road) and towards the West being partly on the Lot Numbered Seventy-one
(71) and being partly on the Lot numbered Seventy-two (72) or however else
the same may abut and abound which said parcel of land is more particularly
delineated and shown coloured pink on the plan of the area attached hereto.
